Nightmare used to name one specific thing.

A mare was a spirit people believed sat on a sleeper's chest. The weight, the not being able to move, the certainty something is in the room. We call it sleep paralysis now.

They had a word for it before they had an explanation.

Comment SEASONAL and I'll send you the weekly note.

Disney would not put its own name on it.

The Nightmare Before Christmas came out under Touchstone in 1993 because the studio decided it was too dark for the Disney label.

The part they were embarrassed by is the part they sell every October.

Follow for the real one, every season. The note is in my bio.
